verdicts.evidence: All three cards end at their last feature line (Email reminders, Reports, Priority support) and have no button or link; the only action is "Start free" in the header, and there is empty white space below the cards.
The Solo, Team and Business cards have the same size, border and styling, the three prices are the same size, and the "Pricing" heading is the largest text on the page.
Solo lists Booking page and Email reminders, Team lists neither, only Business lists Single sign-on, and no card says "Everything in" any other plan.
The sub-line reads "Simple plans for teams of every size. Change or cancel whenever you like." and the only hint of what Tidewell does is the calendar and booking items in the feature lists.
